facts.statement: MaleCNS contains the audited body-ID-resolved FB5AB/PFN to hDeltaC/hDeltaG to PFL structural candidate route.
facts.caveat: Structural connectivity does not establish physiological transmission or navigation function.

facts.statement: MaleCNS contains the audited EPG/Delta7 to PFL3 heading-route structure.
facts.caveat: Anatomical route and topography do not establish a universal physical heading angle map.

forbidden_claims: universal PB label to world-angle mapping

facts.statement: Frozen integration populations have catalog-predicted neurotransmitter annotations with retained confidence.
facts.caveat: Predicted transmitter identity is not a measured postsynaptic physiological sign.

facts.statement: FC2 populations have catalog-predicted transmitter annotations used only as a modeling convention.
facts.caveat: This does not establish measured goal tuning or postsynaptic effect.

facts.statement: A deterministic explicit rate model propagates mirrored PFL3 drive through the restricted steering scaffold into opposite modeled DNa02 turn signals.
facts.caveat: Modeled propagation is not measured firing and is not behavioral qualification.

facts.statement: The steering probe depends on explicit signed-rate-model assumptions.
facts.caveat: Partial lesion amplitudes are descriptive under postsynaptic normalization.

facts.statement: MaleCNS contains strong audited hDeltaK/PFGs structural recurrence.
facts.caveat: Structural recurrence alone is not evidence of persistent activity, memory, or attractor dynamics.

facts.statement: Independent Drosophila experiments support directional wind tuning in PFN pathways that provide wind information to the fan-shaped body.
facts.caveat: Measured in another Drosophila preparation, not the exact MaleCNS v1.0 body IDs.

facts.statement: Independent Drosophila experiments show hDeltaC activity is odor-gated and wind-direction tuned after convergence of odor and wind pathways.
facts.caveat: Measured in another Drosophila preparation and cannot be promoted to MaleCNS-specific physiology.

allowed_claims: cross-dataset physiological prior for PFN wind tuning and odor-context gating

facts.statement: Independent Drosophila experiments show individual PFL3 neurons have conjunctive spike-rate tuning to heading and goal angle and support an egocentric steering computation.
facts.caveat: Measured in another Drosophila preparation and not on the exact MaleCNS v1.0 body IDs.

metadata.underlying_evidence: measured spike-rate physiology and optogenetic intervention

allowed_claims: cross-dataset physiological prior for PFL3 heading-goal steering computation

facts.statement: Independent bilateral DNa02 recordings show fly rotational velocity is approximately linearly related to right-left DNa02 firing-rate difference over the measured dynamic range.
facts.caveat: Measured in walking Drosophila, not the exact MaleCNS v1.0 body IDs.

facts.statement: The DNa02 steering study compares neural activity with behavior about 150 ms later, while explicitly noting that the lag may reflect biological delay and/or spherical-treadmill inertia.
facts.caveat: This observation is not a direct neural time-constant measurement and is therefore not eligible to calibrate the model time constant.

metadata.underlying_evidence: neural-to-behavior lag with explicit mechanical confound

allowed_claims: cross-dataset physiological prior for bilateral DNa02 steering
forbidden_claims: 150 ms is the DNa02 neural time constant
